All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BaseClientConnection
The BaseClientConnection class provides a low-level client-side socket connection for sending and receiving BasePacket objects.
BasePacket
Represents a generic packet for the lottery system.
BaseServerConnection
The BaseServerConnection class provides a low-level server-side socket implementation for receiving and responding to BasePacket objects.
Client
The Client class represents an object-oriented lottery client that interacts with the DNS and Seller servers to participate in lottery draws.
ClientConnection
Represents a client-side connection capable of connecting to a server, sending packets, and disconnecting.
ClientSocket
The ClientSocket class represents the entry point for running a lottery client that repeatedly participates in lottery draws.
Configuration
 
Constants
 
DNS
The DNS class serves as the entry point for launching the DNSSocket server in the lottery network.
DNSConnectPacket
Represents a DNS connection packet used to notify the DNS server about a server's connection or disconnection.
DNSConnectPacket.Type
Defines the type of DNS packet: connection or disconnection.
DNSRequestPacket
Represents a DNS request packet sent from a client to the DNS server.
DNSResponsePacket
Represents a DNS response packet sent from the DNS server to a client.
DNSSocket
The DNSSocket class represents a lightweight DNS-like service used within the lottery system for service discovery and registration.
PacketBuilder
Builder and factory for creating BasePacket instances from ByteBuffer data.
PacketHandleRegistry
 
PacketUtils
Utility class for encoding and decoding primitive data types and strings into and from ByteBuffer objects.
Seller
Represents a lottery seller node responsible for: Registering and unregistering itself with a DNS service. Handling client requests for lottery draws (sorteos). Communicating with the main lottery server to process requests.
SellerSocket
The SellerSocket class is the main entry point for starting a lottery seller client.
Server
The Server class represents the central lottery server responsible for generating and validating winning numbers in the lottery system.
ServerConnection
Represents a server-side connection capable of accepting client connections, listening for incoming packets, and managing the server lifecycle.
ServerSocket
The ServerSocket class is the entry point for starting the main lottery server that handles incoming lottery draw requests from sellers.
SorteoRequestPacket
Represents a lottery draw request packet sent from a client to the server.
SorteoResponsePacket
Represents a lottery draw response packet sent from the server to the client.
